title: When Less is More: The LLM Scaling Paradox in Context Compression
abstract: arXiv:2602.09789v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scaling up model parameters has long been a prevalent training paradigm driven by the assumption that larger models yield superior generation capabilities. However, under lossy context compression in a compressor--decoder setup, we find a \textbf{\textit{Size-Fidelity Paradox}}: increasing compressor size can lessen the faithfulness of reconstructed contexts though reconstruction error decreases. Across 27 compressor setups spanning model families, scales, and compression rates, we coin this paradox arising from two dominant factors: 1) \textit{knowledge overwriting}: larger models increasingly replace source facts with their own prior beliefs, \textit{e.g.}, ``the white strawberry`` $\to$ ``the red strawberry``; and 2) \textit{semantic drift}: larger models tend to paraphrase or restructure content instead of reproducing it verbatim, \textit{e.g.}, ``Alice hit Bob`` $\to$ ``Bob hit Alice``. translated_title: 少即是多：上下文压缩中的大语言模型规模悖论
translated_abstract: 扩大模型参数规模长期以来一直是一种主流的训练范式，其背后的假设是更大的模型能带来更优的生成能力。然而，在压缩器-解码器架构下的有损上下文压缩任务中，我们发现了一个“规模-保真度悖论”：增大压缩器的规模虽然降低了重建误差，反而会削弱重建上下文的忠实度。在涵盖不同模型家族、规模和压缩率的27种压缩器设置中，我们将这一悖论归因于两个主要因素：1）知识覆写：更大的模型越来越多地用自己的先验信念替换源文本中的事实，例如将“白色草莓”改写为“红色草莓”；2）语义漂移：更大的模型倾向于对内容进行改写或重组，而非逐字复现，例如将“Alice打了Bob”改写为"Bob打了Alice"。有趣的是，这一悖论在不同设置下持续存在。
tldr: 该论文发现上下文压缩中存在“规模-保真度悖论”：增大压缩器模型规模虽能降低重建误差，却因知识覆写和语义漂移反而损害了重建上下文的忠实度。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a Size-Fidelity Paradox in lossy context compression, where scaling up compressor models—despite reducing reconstruction error—actually undermines context reconstruction faithfulness due to knowledge overwriting and semantic drift.
